in_arabic.name: ميشباہ
in_arabic.meaning: مصباح، نور کی روشنی، روشن کرنے والا، چراغ
in_arabic.long_meaning: الميشباہ مشتق من مصباح، وهو شيء يُستخدم لإضاءة المكان، ويدل على نور وهداية، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَجَعَلَ لَنا لِلمُقيمينَ بِهِ رِزقاً كَفافاً وَمُصابيحَ وَحَشاً مِن كُلِّ شيءٍ'، ويُستخدم كاسم للدلالة على الشخص الذي يضفي نوراً وإضاءة في حياة الآخرين

in_urdu.name: میشباہ
in_urdu.meaning: روشنی کا مصدر، چراغ، نور کی روشنی، روشن کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: میشباہ عربی زبان کا ایک نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے روشنی کا مصدر یا چراغ۔ یہ نام ان خواص کے لیے منتخب کیا جاتا ہے جو दूसरों کی زندگی میں نور و روشنی لاتے ہیں۔ اس کا تعلق قرآن کی آیات سے بھی جڑا ہوا ہے جہاں مصباح کا ذکر نور اور ہدایت کے طور پر کیا گیا ہے

in_hindi.name: मिशबाह
in_hindi.meaning: नूर का स्रोत, चराग, प्रकाश का स्रोत, रोशन करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मिशबाह एक ऐसा नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और जिसका अर्थ है नूर का स्रोत या चराग। यह नाम उन विशेषताओं के लिए चुना जाता है जो दूसरों की जिंदगी में प्रकाश और मार्गदर्शन लाते हैं। इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में भी है जहाँ इसे हिदायत और ज्ञान के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है

in_pashto.name: ميشباہ
in_pashto.meaning: د رڼا سرچینه، څراغ، د نور سرچینه، روښان کونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: ميشباہ د يوه نوم دی چې د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی او معنی يې د رڼا سرچینه يا څراغ دی. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي کوم چې د نورو په ژوند کې رڼا او هدايت راوړي. دا نوم د افغانستان په اسلامي دوديزو کې هم ځای لري او د پوهې او حکمت د نښه په توګه ګڼل کیږي

in_english.name: Mishbaah
in_english.meaning: Source of light, lamp, illuminator, radiant
in_english.long_meaning: Mishbaah is an Arabic name that means 'source of light' or 'lamp'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'm-s-b-h' which is related to light and illumination. In Islamic tradition, the name Mishbaah is associated with guidance and wisdom. It is mentioned in the Quran in various contexts, symbolizing light and spiritual guidance. The name conveys the idea of someone who brings illumination and clarity to others' lives, reflecting positive attributes such as wisdom, knowledge, and spirituality

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, Mishbaah is a name that holds deep significance and is associated with guidance and enlightenment. The name is derived from the Arabic word "mishbah," which means a lamp or a light. As a name for a person, Mishbaah signifies that the individual is a beacon of light, a guide for others to follow, and a source of knowledge and wisdom. In Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) is often referred to as the "Mishbah" or "The Light of Guidance," reflecting his role in leading people to the true path.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mishbaah represents a person who embodies the qualities of guidance, wisdom, and enlightenment. The individual with this name is called to use their knowledge and light to guide others towards the right path in life and to illuminate the way for those who may be lost. In Islamic belief, every individual has the potential to be a source of guidance and light to others, reflecting the collective responsibility of the community to support and uplift one another. The name Mishbaah is a reminder of the spiritual importance of being a positive influence on those around us and being a source of light and guidance for our loved ones and those in need.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Abd al-Barr, Ibn Abi Dunya, and Ibn Asakir mention Mishbaah as a title given to Al-Hasan Al-Basri, a prominent early Islamic scholar and ascetic. He is reported to have spent his nights in prayer and worship, and his days in teaching and preaching. His disciples called him Mishbaah, which means 'torch' or 'lamp', due to his enlightening effect on their spiritual development.

Al-Maqrizi, in his historical work 'Al-Itqan fi Ma'rifat Al-Khawarizmiyah', mentions Mishbaah as a title for Al-Hasan Al-Hussein Al-Basri, the great grandson of Al-Hasan Al-Basri and a famous Sufi saint. He is described as a beacon of guidance for his followers, and the title Mishbaah was given to him in recognition of his enlightening influence and spiritual guidance.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Mishbaah in Islamic context refers to a light or lamp that illuminates the path. This concept is deeply rooted in Islamic art and culture, where it is represented through intricate geometric patterns and calligraphy. On Instagram, it can be seen in the form of beautifully curated feeds showcasing Islamic art, calligraphy, and interior design. On Pinterest, Mishbaah is the inspiration behind boards featuring Islamic art, architecture, and home decor. Lastly, on Etsy, one can find a wide range of Mishbaah-inspired home decor items, from lanterns and lamps to wall art and throw pillows. The trend towards embracing Mishbaah in modern life reflects a growing interest in Islamic art and culture, as well as a desire for spirituality, self-care, and the creation of aesthetically pleasing environments.
